places.getThere: From Hanoi a bus or limousine van takes about 5 h (about 230 km) via Thai Nguyen, around 200,000 – 300,000 VND; many operators stop at the lake boat pier or Cho Ra town. The nearest airport is Noi Bai (HAN).

days.title: 河内 – 前往巴贝
days.morning: About 5 hours (230 km) by bus or limousine van from Hanoi via Thai Nguyen.
days.afternoon: Check in to a stilt-house homestay at Pac Ngoi and stroll the lakeside village.
days.evening: Grilled lake fish, five-colour sticky rice and Then singing.

days.title: 乘船游湖 – 蓬洞 – 头党瀑布
days.morning: Hire a boat at the pier: Ba Goa islet, Ao Tien pond and An Ma temple.
days.afternoon: Follow the Nang River through Puong cave to Dau Dang waterfall, then walk about 500 m to the best tier.
days.evening: Dinner back in the village and the lake at dusk.

days.title: 皮划艇 – 博卢、谷德村
days.morning: Kayak or take a dugout canoe on the lake in the morning mist.
days.afternoon: Cycle or walk round the lake via Bo Lu, Coc Toc and Po Lu villages.
days.evening: Roast pork with mac mat leaves and corn wine by the fire.

days.title: 华马洞 – 竹腊市场
days.morning: Climb up to Hua Ma cave and its tiers of stalactites.
days.afternoon: Cho Ra market: dried bamboo shoots, arrowroot noodles and coóc mò cakes to take home.
days.evening: Dinner in Cho Ra town and a quiet evening.

days.title: 经太原茶山返回河内
days.morning: Leave Ba Be early – about 3 hours by road to Thai Nguyen city and the Museum of Cultures of Vietnam's Ethnic Groups.
days.afternoon: Tan Cuong tea hills: taste and buy tea, then on to Hanoi (about 1.5 h).
